name: Omega Plexo
author: omega
description: Multi-network downloads, from the bar. Omega Plexo drives Plexo's engine headlessly (built on Plexo by Anmol Kapil, MIT): the bar shows the machine's live internet speed across every connected network, starts and controls downloads, and can optionally send every app's traffic over all links at once.

barWidget.description: The machine's live internet speed over every network. Click for downloads and per-link control.
